verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at rocm.docs.amd.com, the documentation home for the MI355X's ROCm software stack, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The file's note says ROCm docs are split across multiple projects, each with its own file. Only the opening lines were captured, the markdown-page variant returned 404, and nothing shows how deep or useful the file is for agents. missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (the .md probe returned 404), evidence of llms.txt content depth and coverage across the split projects (including instinct.docs.amd.com), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://rocm.docs.amd.com/llms.txt # ROCm documentation
